skills.name: Basic fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions that already have a common denominator.

skills.name: Finding LCD and converting
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Separate whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Separating mixed numbers or whole numbers into whole and fractional parts to perform subtraction.

skills.name: Borrowing in mixed numbers
skills.definition: Borrowing from the whole number part to resolve a negative fractional subtraction result.

skills.name: Simplifying fractions
skills.definition: Reducing the resulting fraction to its simplest/lowest terms.
